products.title: 9 OZ. CANDLE
products.body_html:
Transform your space with the warm, inviting glow of our 9 OZ Candle. Whether you’re looking to create a relaxing sanctuary after a long day or add a touch of elegance to your home decor, this premium scented jar candle delivers a clean, consistent burn and a room-filling aroma.

Crafted with sustainability in mind, our candles are made from 100% natural soy wax and a lead-free cotton wick, ensuring a non-toxic experience for you and your family.

Long-Lasting Burn: Enjoy 50–60 hours of aromatic bliss.

Eco-Friendly Materials: Made with renewable soy wax and a 100% cotton wick for a soot-free burn.

Premium Fragrance Oils: Infused with high-quality, phthalate-free oils for a strong "scent throw" (both hot and cold).

Reusable Glass Jar: Our sleek 9 oz. straight-sided jar can be easily cleaned and repurposed as a minimalist planter or storage.

Hand-Poured Quality: Each candle is poured in small batches in the USA to ensure the highest quality and attention to detail.
